result.title: LIRQuant: An Efficient Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization Method for Large Language Models
result.summary: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LIRQuant 训练后量化框架，按噪声加权敏感度挑选敏感通道，仅对其施加可学习旋转、其余通道用固定旋转，以在 W4A4KV4 下提升 LLM 精度与部署效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文处理的是 LLM 低比特量化的激活离群值与旋转变换，不涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据使用或推理期计算决策，也未给出可迁移到 latent visual reasoning 的具体方法线索。
